_readme: K2's open request list for K1, and the overlay K2's tests put on top of the real src/data/nasa_data.json. 'add' holds entries nasa_data.json does not have yet; 'fill' holds row fields that are missing or null there. The numbers are TEST values (src PLACEHOLDER): K1 sets the real game values (D-009). When K1 adds an entry, delete it here. Still missing too, not overlaid here because it is a table: relayPasses [{ id, name, atSolFraction, mbit }] and an Earth-Mars light-delay table.

survivalPointsPerSol.note: survival points for each sol lived through (scored as it happens)

launchPoints.note: the MAV lifts off: safe return (survival)

missedLaunchPoints.note: launch window closed with the MAV too cold (lostSystems)

beamWidthDeg.note: K3 draft (stub_samples alignRows): simplified beam, wide enough to find by ear

count.note: how many spare kits this option carries
